_note: Blocks an ENTRY if price sits just below the nearest overhead support/resistance zone (pivot-clustered swing highs, min_touches required - same logic and same config/levels.json params as scripts/levels.py). proximity_pct = how close below that zone's near edge counts as 'too close'. Price already ABOVE the zone, or no zone found above price, always passes (fail_mode decides the latter). exempt_strategies: strategies here are NEVER evaluated by this check (opt-OUT, default empty, same convention as quality.json's own exempt_strategies). sr_reversal is exempt: this filter exists to stop a BREAKOUT strategy buying under an unbroken ceiling, but sr_reversal's own profit target IS the next resistance zone above - a tight support-to-resistance range is its setup, not something to avoid, so this filter was blocking its best, most textbook range trades. See trader/filters/resistance.py docstring for the full diagnosis.
